Cold Buster Citrus Smoothie
By: Karen Kelly
Published: Monday, January 23, 2017 - 6:40am

Ingredients




2 peeled oranges
½ cup frozen mango chunks
1 banana
½ - 1 cup coconut water

Preparation

1 Add all ingredients into a high powered blender and blitz until blended. 2 Add more or less coconut water to desired consistency. 3 Enjoy!

About

Got a cold? It's time to blast it out with this Vitamin C loaded orange Cold Buster Citrus Smoothie. Fresh, filling and oh so delicious.
